title: Negative-coordinate count
statement: For a finite coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a point $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, define the negative-coordinate count on $S$ to be the number of coordinates $i\in S$ for which $x_i=−1$.
